package_purpose: Source data for manual product acceptance, NOT a generated or validated BladeGen result.
reference_model: Official NASA X-57 Maxwell CRM v4.4.1 OpenVSP model
data_origin: Previously uploaded x57_hlp_blade_reference.json; extracted in earlier project work from official model. Official original is not re-downloaded in this preparation.
transforms_applied_to_data: diameter/radius meters converted to mm by multiplying by 1000
chord/rake/skew normalized controls multiplied by radius_mm for display sheet
zero third coordinate omitted from explicit-surface airfoil CSV
no resampling, no smoothing, no shape-fitting, no chord-line rotation, no CAD generation
caveats: Keep explicit-surface CSV normalization OFF to preserve source coordinates.
Current UI assigns imported profile geometric t/c. A source native spline-thickness versus polygon-measurement difference must be recorded, not silently claimed exact.
Native source OpenVSP PCHIP and product SciPy PCHIP must be compared; equal controls do not assert identical intermediate surfaces.
Official HLP has 5 blades; current qualified assembly supports 2-4. Single-blade acceptance only.
Use original official VSP3 reference for final geometric comparison. Do not use a previously rebuilt BladeGen output as the ground truth.
This package has not been run end-to-end in the current application and has no PASS classification.
